messages:
Elena (Partner Ops): Heads-up — QBR next Wed. Need final partner scorecards + MDF asks in by EOD Monday so we can fold into the deck. I pulled last quarter spends and there are 3 partners asking for re-tiering and a marketplace co-marketing pilot.
Mike (Strategic Partnerships): Ok noted. Which partners are in play for the MDF pilot?
Elena (Partner Ops): Tentative list: CloudX (marketplace listing push), NovaHW (hardware promo at Summit), and IntegrateCo (SI-led pilot). Pilot budget ask: $120k total (split 60/40 dev + co-marketing). Draft rationale in this thread bottom.
Sanjay (Finance): 120k is doable but need justification per partner scorecard. We should map expected ARR uplift / deal conversions. For each partner we need: baseline ARR, target uplift, timeline, and KPIs.
Tess (Sales Ops): I can run a pipeline lift estimate for CloudX and IntegrateCo. Do we have the recent win rates for Marketplace listings?
Priya (Marketplace): Marketplace lift avg = 18% conversion uplift over 90 days for similar listings. For CloudX I can get the historical click-to-trial numbers by EOD.
Elena (Partner Ops): Thanks. Proposal for the QBR slide set: 1) one-slide ask per partner with "ask, rationale, expected lift, SDR/AE enablement plan" 2) combined MDF bucket ask with contingency 3) recommended tier adjustments with scorecard deltas.
Mike (Strategic Partnerships): On tier changes — recommend we add a temporary 'Pilot' tier for partners on trial MDF (3-month). Keeps expectations clear and avoids permanent re-tiering. Thoughts? :thinking_face:
Sanjay (Finance): Pilot tier makes sense as a ring-fenced budget. Need criteria: minimum co-funding %, commit to 2 joint GTM activities, and measurable KPIs (leads, pipeline $).
Tess (Sales Ops): Proposed criteria from sales: 20% co-funding for marketplace, 30% for hardware events, commit to 1 co-branded event + 2 asset pieces. Also require partner-sourced pipeline tracked in SFDC campaign.
Elena (Partner Ops): Sounds good. I'm drafting a short rubric: "Pilot eligibility = partner fit + co-fund + SFDC tracking + A/B playbook commit." Will attach doc.
ops-bot: Reminder: QBR presentation deck template has been shared in #all-hands. Deadline triggered for partnerships: 1794033600.
Priya (Marketplace): Quick ask — can we earmark $30k of the MDF for paid marketplace placement (featured slot)? That's the thing that drives the lift for CloudX.
Sanjay (Finance): Approve earmark conditional on CloudX ROI estimate. If expected payback < 6 months we greenlight.
Mike (Strategic Partnerships): I'll queue a 15-min sync with CloudX PMs tomorrow to get conversion estimates and co-funding confirmation. @Tess please join.
Tess (Sales Ops): I'll be there. Also will export win-rate by campaign for the past 6 months before the sync.
Elena (Partner Ops): Action items:
- Mike: confirm CloudX co-fund + conversion numbers (due tomorrow EOD)
- Priya: provide marketplace CTR -> trial numbers (EOD)
- Tess: pipeline lift estimate + win rates (tomorrow morning)
- Sanjay: MDF budget modelling + payback thresholds (Monday)
- Elena: consolidate slides and tier pilot rubric, circulate draft (Monday noon)
If anyone can't hit these dates, flag now.
Mike (Strategic Partnerships): All good from me.
Priya (Marketplace): On it.
Sanjay (Finance): Will start model Friday.
Tess (Sales Ops): Got it.
Elena (Partner Ops): TL;DR: Need scorecards + MDF asks by Monday EOD. Pilot-tier concept approved in principle — details + ROI will lock the final allocation. :thumbsup:
Mike (Strategic Partnerships): One more note — IntegrateCo asked for co-dev credits vs cash. We should include that option in the rubric (credits count toward co-fund at fair-market rate).
Elena (Partner Ops): Good call. I'll add credits conversion formula to the rubric (e.g., dev credit rate = $X/hr * committed hours).
Priya (Marketplace): Also linking the draft doc: https://docs.redwood.com/partners/qbr/mar-2026-mdf-draft (will update with numbers)
Elena (Partner Ops): Perfect — I'll pull everything into the QBR slides by Monday and post for review. Thanks team!
